title: Moroccan Chicken Stir Fry
description:
A flavorful and spicy stir fry made with marinated chicken, 
                   exotic spices, and a nutty crunch. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the nutty, gooey, and moroccan spices and stir to combine.
Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the honey and cook for an additional minute.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
